content_html:
Lima, the capital of Peru, is much more than a connection point to Machu Picchu. It is a coastal city full of history, culture and one of the most outstanding cuisines in the world. Each visit to Lima becomes an unforgettable experience.

From the moment you land, every corner has something to surprise you: Colonial architecture, urban art, views of the Pacific and unique flavors that conquer any palate.
Although sometimes it goes unnoticed.

What makes Lima special?

Imagine Lima as a great cultural restaurant:

  1. You (as a traveler) place your order: history, beach, art, food.
  2. The city receives your request with warmth.
  3. Look for the best: museums, bohemian neighborhoods, ceviches or sunsets.
  4. And it serves you in a matter of minutes.

From the Miraflores boardwalk to the Bridge of Sighs in Barranco, Lima has something special for everyone.

Who should visit Lima?

Lima is ideal for:

  • Lovers of good food and gourmet experiences.
  • Travelers interested in history and colonial architecture.
  • Adventurers looking for sea, surf or urban culture.
  • Tourists who enjoy the fusion between modern and traditional.

Why is it worth knowing Lima?

Traveling to Lima offers you:

  • Coastal settings and incredible sea views.
  • Gastronomy recognized worldwide.
  • Unique historical sites and museums in South America.
  • An artistic and cultural scene in constant movement.

In summary:

  • Lima, Peru It is a vibrant city, with its own identity and soul.
  • Here the ancestral mixes with the modern, the local with the global.
  • It is the perfect starting point to fall in love with Peru.
